dataset.split_rule: per label: order by sha256('laya-v12:'+id); first 50% train, next 20% dev, last 30% held-out

protocol.train: fit temperature (+ optional per-class log-bias, L2 0.05), abstention tau / consistency / noul gate by train utility
protocol.dev: choose among the 10 pre-declared candidates (criteria v11|v12 x ensemble single|orders3|orders3x2 [v12 only] x bias off|on) by dev utility, ties by dev NLL
protocol.held_out: reported once for the chosen configuration; the other candidates are also listed below for transparency, not for selection
protocol.label_policy: family that should act FIRST; missing, contradictory, multi-fault-without-first-move or high-impact requests -> human_review
protocol.abstention: advisory deferred to human_review; counts as predicting human_review in accuracy; override-routed cases are counted as answered

caveats: 151 hand-written cases by one author; held-out n=48 -> wide intervals (Wilson 95% shown)
Laya is zero-shot (no fine-tuning); calibration and thresholds are post-hoc fits on 73 train cases
dev has only 30 cases: the candidate choice is noisy
Laya confidence/ensemble numbers are never used to gate actions (advisory)
latency measured on a shared 20-core box under load average 27.77; CPU torch, warm
the rule baseline and Nano see text only (no asset ids / numerics)
Nano confidence is verbalised, uncalibrated, and gets no abstention gate
criteria wording v12 was written after reading Agent C's V11 cases (not the new set's outputs)

engines_summary.laya_router: V12 final: calibrated order/paraphrase ensemble + abstention + safety override

laya_v11_shipped_policy.policy: V11 as shipped: criteria v11, one forward pass, abstain if entropy-confidence < 0.5 or noul > 0.5, then safety override

rule_fallback_NOT_LAYA.policy: keyword rules (abstain when confidence < 0.65 or insufficient flag) + safety override; text only (no asset id / numerics)
rule_fallback_NOT_LAYA.note: rule confidences are hand-set constants, not probabilities; ECE here only shows they are not calibrated

crusoe_nano.policy: Crusoe Nano, one call, JSON family + verbalised confidence (no abstention gate of its own) + the same safety override

laya_v12_final.n_cases_note: Agent C's 36 V11 held-out cases (text + asset id as the V11 benchmark fed them)

nano.policy: Crusoe Nano, one call, JSON family + verbalised confidence (no abstention gate of its own) + the same safety override

legacy_v11_heldout_36.note: Agent C's V11 numbers on this set (raw Laya 0.33 acc, ECE 0.084, 78% abstain at tau 0.5) are in V11_EVAL.md; wording of the V12 criteria was written after reading these cases, so treat this as a second, partly-seen set

safety_override.note: deterministic, applied after every engine; recall below 100% means the regexes miss phrasing: the advisory is not a safety system

note_compat: keys laya_router / rule_fallback_NOT_LAYA / laya_router_loaded keep the V11 artifact shape that tests/test_v11_eval.py and /api/v1/eval/scorecard?laya=1 consumers expect
